definitions.explanation: The total amount of money received from selling goods or services.

examples.japanese: {今月|こんげつ}の{売上|うりあげ}は{先月|せんげつ}より{増|ふ}えた。
examples.english: This month's sales increased compared to last month.

examples.japanese: {売上|うりあげ}{目標|もくひょう}を{達成|たっせい}した。
この{店|みせ}の{一日|いちにち}の{売上|うりあげ}は{約|やく}{百万円|ひゃくまんえん}だ。
examples.english: This store's daily sales are about one million yen.

examples.japanese: {新商品|しんしょうひん}のおかげで{売上|うりあげ}が{大|おお}きく{伸|の}びた。
examples.english: Thanks to the new product, sales grew significantly.

examples.japanese: {毎月|まいつき}の{売上|うりあげ}をグラフにまとめて{社長|しゃちょう}に{報告|ほうこく}している。
examples.english: I compile the monthly sales into a graph and report to the company president.

notes:
USAGE: {売上|うりあげ} is a fundamental business term used for revenue from sales.

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
・{売上|うりあげ}{高|だか} (sales amount, sales volume)
・{売上|うりあげ}{金|きん} (sales proceeds)
・{売上|うりあげ}{目標|もくひょう} (sales target)
・{売上|うりあげ}{報告|ほうこく} (sales report)
・{売上|うりあげ}ランキング (sales ranking)

WRITING VARIATIONS: Can also be written as {売り上げ|うりあげ}.

RELATED:
・{収益|しゅうえき} - revenue, earnings
・{利益|りえき} - profit (after costs)
・{売れ行き|うれゆき} - sales performance, how well something sells
